title: Pittsburg Historical Museum

services.name: Commercial Fishing
services.desc: During the California Gold Rush the bounty of the sea was discovered right here in the Sacramento Delta. Salmon and other fish species began to be harvested chiefly by Sicilian and Greek fishermen on a small scale here in New York Landing by the early 1850s and it grew into a large scale commercial fishing and canning
